text:
Maya: hi team, I'm Maya (joined last week). I'm oncall for the first rotation Fri -> Mon. quick q: what's the preferred flow for practicing runbooks before live?
Ethan: welcome Maya! Best flow: read the runbook, run the staging playbook, then shadow a live page. takes ~2 hours per service.
Maya: where are the staging playbooks? i couldn't find them in docs search.
Priya: they live under docs.oncall/staging_playbooks. alias: https://confluence.redwood/staging-playbooks. check 'read-only-mode' and 'leader-election' first.
Maya: got it. do I need access to anything special for staging (k8s, db console)?
Ethan: staging access is gated. file a request to #eng-identity with the template in pinned messages. include your manager and mention 'oncall-shadow'.
oncall-bot: action_required: new_shadow_request for Maya. Reminder: complete PagerDuty device registration: https://pd.redwood/setup
Maya: PD is set up but i can't receive SMS verif code. anyone else had that?
Darren: occasionally carrier blocks SMS for company numbers. try the authenticator app as backup or use the backup phone option.
Maya: ok switching to authenticator now.
Priya: tip: run the staging drill with ops-shadow-bot first. it simulates a noisy alert and walks through 'isolate-service' steps.
ops-shadow-bot: scheduled simulation: staging-drill for Maya on Thu 16:00. auto-invite sent.
Maya: thanks. question about escalation: if the incident has partial customer impact but we can mitigate via fallback, do we still page the service owner?
Ethan: yes page them. We prefer to notify owners early. If it's mitigated with fallback, document the mitigation and open follow-up ticket.
Priya: follow-ups go into the 'post-incident' board with tag 'oncall-followup'. assign a lead for RCA within 3 business days.
Maya: what's the preferred handoff message at shift end?
Darren: short and structured. Example:
```
/handoff
Shift: Maya -> Darren
Incidents: svc-api-503 (mitigated)
Status: fallback enabled, latency normalized
Followup: investigate cache saturation, assign ticket #4321
```
Maya: cool. is it ok to mute noisy alerts during maintenance windows?
Ethan: yes, but add a note and blameless comment, and ensure pager-suppress policy is documented in the maintenance ticket.
Maya: final: any quick 'do not do' rules for first-timers?
Priya: don't make config changes without a second set of eyes for production. if you're unsure, escalate.
Darren: and don't forget to update the runbook if you find a missing step during an incident. small docs fixes save time later.
Maya: thanks all. I'll join the Thu drill and sign up for a shadow slot Fri morning.
oncall-bot: reminder: oncall-bootcamp Fri 09:30 (calendar invite sent).
Ethan: welcome aboard again! ping any of us for pairing this week.
Maya: appreciate it :heart:
